speaker_role: independent counselor (Craig Meister, college admissions coach)
commercial_incentive: Sells one-on-one coaching, a short course and a paid application pre-read, and pitches them repeatedly.
key_insights: Treat the optional LMU essay as effectively expected, since completing it conveys fit and separates you from those who skip it.
Uses a traditional structure: intro with thesis previewing two or three reasons, a body paragraph per reason, and a reflective new conclusion.
Overdraft, then trim to roughly 450-500 words.
Research the school so the essay shows real knowledge of fit.
specific_numbers_or_facts: Speaker says LMU early decision acceptance is high 50s to low 60s percent, early action low 50s, regular decision high 20s to low 30s.
Prompt is 500 words: why LMU and/or why your major.
LMU scores are optional; course and grade section of Common App is required, per speaker.
notable_or_distinctive: Gives one school's ED/EA/RD acceptance-rate bands alongside prompt advice.
reliability_notes: Heavy sales framing and repetitive filler; acceptance rates are approximate, unsourced and possibly dated.
